name: io.github.Kanasjnr/midnight-cast
title: midnight-cast
description: Read-only tools for live Midnight networks: health, transactions, DUST, errors and example code

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKFROST_PREPROD_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Blockfrost project ID for a Midnight Preprod project, needed only to query preprod. It is never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKFROST_MAINNET_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Blockfrost project ID for a Midnight Mainnet project, needed only to query mainnet. It is never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: MIDNIGHT_CAST_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated networks the model may query, such as preview,preprod. Default: every built-in network.
